description.value: Kome Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Williams Lake offering online ordering and pickup, specializing in Aburi (flame-seared) oshi sushi and premium ingredients including imported Hon Maguro Bluefin tuna, Hokkaido scallop, and real wasabi. The menu spans classic rolls, sashimi platters, nigiri, donburi, and starters alongside beer and Japanese sake. For a touring cyclist passing through the Cariboo, it stands out as an unusually refined sushi option in a small Interior BC city.

address.value: 24 2nd Avenue South, Unit F, Williams Lake, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (kome-sushi.square.site) confirms the business name, location ('Williams Lake, BC'), and address ('24F Second Ave S'), consistent with OSM tags. The site is an active Square online ordering platform listing menu items and a pickup time, confirming the business is open. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere on the site; Takeout/pickup is the explicit business model per the 'Online Order & Pickup' heading.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Williams Lake with a live ordering website; a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal.
